signup.title: Create your He-API account
signup.subtitle: Use your email and a strong password.
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. We check against known breached passwords.
signup.termsNotice: By signing up you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

signupCheckInbox.title: Check your inbox
signupCheckInbox.description: We sent a verification link to {email}. The link expires in 24 hours.
signupCheckInbox.supportNote: Still nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder or contact support.

verifyEmail.successDescription: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.alreadyVerifiedDescription: This email has already been verified.
verifyEmail.tokenUsedDescription: This verification link has already been used. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.tokenExpiredDescription: This link is older than 24 hours. Request a new verification email.
verifyEmail.resendModalDescription: Enter your email and we'll send a new verification link.
verifyEmail.resendSentTitle: We sent you a new link
verifyEmail.resendSentDescription: If an account exists for this email, you'll receive a new verification link shortly.

lockedScreen.title: Account temporarily locked
lockedScreen.description: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.passwordBreached: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.hibpUnavailable: We couldn't verify your password against the breach database. Please try again in a minute.
errors.tokenAlreadyUsed: The verification link has already been used.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in {seconds}s.
errors.tooManyAttemptsIp: Too many attempts from your network. Please try again in {seconds}s.
errors.tooManyAttemptsEmail: Too many attempts for this email. Please try again in {seconds}s.
errors.tooManyResendAttempts: You can request a new link in {seconds}s.
errors.resendTooSoon: Please wait {seconds}s before requesting another email.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password you entered is incorrect.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before signing in.
errors.accountLocked: Your account is locked. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).
errors.accountSuspended: Your account is suspended. Contact support for help.
errors.accountDeleted: This account is pending deletion. Contact support to reactivate.
errors.serverUnavailable: We're having trouble reaching the server. Please retry.
errors.emailSendFailed: Account created, but we couldn't send the verification email. Click below to resend.
